_note: social-domain-consent-and-safeguards task 1.1 (openspec/changes/social-domain-consent-and-safeguards): four safeguards a case type switches on as configuration (decision 182), so the consent, classification, team-only and anonymised-export capabilities stay generic and a procedure only sets flags. The flags are declared here and set by the social packages; their readers land with tasks 2 to 4 of that change (the consent check on the share paths, the classification at intake, the read rule, the anonymised export). caseType moves to 1.48.0 (1.47.0 is overview-sections) so an existing instance re-imports the schema. A fragment per ADR-037.

requiresConsentForSharing.title: Consent required for sharing
requiresConsentForSharing.description: Whether sharing a case of this type, or its data, with an external party needs a recorded consent that names that party and is valid on the day.

requiresSpecialCategory.title: Special-category classification required
requiresSpecialCategory.description: Whether a case of this type needs its special categories of personal data (GDPR article 9) classified before it is created.

handlingTeamOnly.title: Only the handling team
handlingTeamOnly.description: Whether reading a case of this type is limited to its handling teams. Not enforced yet: until the read rule of this change lands, restrict access through the case type's rights.

identifyingFields.title: Identifying fields
identifyingFields.description: The case properties that identify a person (names, BSN, addresses, birth dates). An anonymised export removes them, reduces an address to its postcode area and a date to its year.
